components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action: theme-aware accent, 52px minimum height, rounded and softly lifted.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard 52px travel-data field with card surface and theme-aware focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input{height:52px;width:100%;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--border,#ddd3c7);border-radius:var(--r-input,14px);background:var(--card,#fffdf8);color:var(--foreground,#28231f);font:400 15px/1.4 Manrope,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;outline:none;transition:border-color var(--t-shift,200ms) var(--ease-standard,cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)),box-shadow var(--t-shift,200ms) var(--ease-standard,cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1));}.ds-input:hover{border-color:color-mix(in oklch,var(--primary,#7a6552) 45%,var(--border,#ddd3c7))}.ds-input:focus-visible{border-color:var(--primary,#7a6552);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch,var(--ring,#7a6552) 45%,transparent)}

components.name: Soft Card
components.description: Primary resting content container: surface contrast first, faint hairline second, soft shadow third.

components.name: Selected Chip
components.description: Quiet selected state using the current theme or section accent rather than a saturated solid fill.
components.css: .ds-chip{height:34px;padding:0 13px;border:1px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--primary,#7a6552) 45%,transparent);border-radius:9999px;background:var(--primary-soft,rgb(122 101 82 / .12));color:var(--foreground,#28231f);font:600 12.5px/1 Manrope,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--t-shift,200ms) var(--ease-standard,cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1));}.ds-chip:hover{background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--primary,#7a6552) 17%,transparent)}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#7a6552);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Five equal app destinations with one moving active pill; icons in the real app are Phosphor and active state also increases icon weight.
components.html: HOMEWORLDTRIPSRECSYOU
components.css: .ds-nav{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:0;padding:8px;border-top:1px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--border,#ddd3c7) 40%,transparent);background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--background,#f7f2e9) 80%,transparent);font-family:Manrope,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-tab{display:flex;min-height:38px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:16px;color:var(--muted-foreground,#746b63);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-decoration:none;transition:color var(--t-tap,120ms) var(--ease-standard,cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)),background var(--t-move,320ms) var(--ease-standard,cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1))}.ds-tab:hover{color:var(--foreground,#28231f)}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#7a6552);outline-offset:1px}.ds-active{background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--tab-accent,var(--primary,#7a6552)) 13%,transparent);color:var(--tab-accent,var(--primary,#7a6552))}

narrative.overview: Béa is a mobile-first editorial travel interface built around warm neutrals, expressive serif hierarchy, compact functional text, softly lifted surfaces, and rounded touch-friendly controls. Calm, Colorful, and Dark share the same geometry and interaction structure. No named creative metaphor has been explicitly approved, so the design record documents the incumbent system without inventing one.
keyCharacteristics: Mobile-first centered shell with modest expansion on larger screens.
Instrument Serif for identity and editorial hierarchy; Manrope for functional UI.
Rounded cards and controls with soft, low-contrast depth.
Three themes share component geometry while Colorful alternates pastel surfaces and section accents.
Maps remain neutral across themes; routes and pins carry map-state color.
Phosphor Regular is the app-wide icon system.

rules.name: The No-Terracotta Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is not part of the approved current visual system. Calm uses warm taupe; Dark uses beige; Colorful uses section-specific accents.

rules.name: The Neutral Map Rule
rules.body: Map baselayers remain neutral in every theme; routes and pins carry state color.

rules.name: The Colorful Mix Rule
rules.body: Colorful is a mixed pastel system rather than a single-hue theme.

rules.name: The Editorial-Only-When-It-Helps Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif carries identity and hierarchy; dense functional text remains Manrope.

rules.name: The Surface-First Rule
rules.body: Prefer surface contrast and tonal layering before adding stronger shadow.

dos: Do preserve all three themes using the same component geometry and interaction structure.
Do use Instrument Serif for editorial hierarchy and Manrope for functional information.
Do keep maps neutral and let routes and pins carry state color.
Do use Phosphor icons from the shared icon wrapper rather than mixing icon families.
Do keep active navigation legible without color alone by using weight and the sliding indicator.
Do reuse shared surface utilities and established touch/spacing tokens before introducing one-off values.
donts: Don't introduce terracotta into the current approved system.
Don't turn Colorful into a single purple, blue, or other one-hue theme; it is deliberately mixed.
Don't mix illustration and real-photo modes on the same screen.
Don't make maps decorative or theme-heavy.
Don't wrap every piece of information in another card.
Don't replace established functions, icons, or product behavior merely to match a visual concept.
